title: chassalia longifolia
intro: Chassalia longifolia, commonly known as the 'Long-leaf Chassalia', is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae, native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
